fields.description: Fieldnames, comma separated, that identify the same record on both sites. Blank: the record's name. Use it where names are random, as on Custom DocPerm: parent, role, permlevel, if_owner.
fields.label: Match On

fields.description: Which records to compare, as Frappe filters in JSON, for example {"is_standard": "No"}. Blank: every record.
fields.label: Filters

fields.description: Fieldnames, comma separated, that change on their own and should not count as a difference. Copying a record leaves them as they are on this site.
fields.label: Ignore Fields
